{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders to focus on completed transactions
completed_df = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute conversion rate by customer_segment
conversion_rates = completed_df.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean()

# Find the segment with the highest conversion rate
best_segment = conversion_rates.idxmax()
best_rate = conversion_rates.max()

print(f"Conversion rates by segment:")
print(conversion_rates)
print(f"\nHighest conversion rate: {best_segment} with {best_rate:.3f}")"}
